newsitem.title: USA: News Corp confirms HarperCollins talks.
newsitem.headline: News Corp confirms HarperCollins talks.

text.p: News Corp said Tuesday the company was exploring a possible joint venture with prospective partners for its HarperCollins book publishing business, including selling a stake in the unit.
"We've been approached by several publishers about a joint venture or ways to share expenses in the back office," a spokesman said.
"There is not a deal per se (currently) being discussed," the spokesman said. "It could include a deal to reduce our stake, or amount to combining (warehouse and distribution) operations."
The spokesman said the talks were preliminary.
News Corp chairman Rupert Murdoch, in a Wall Street Journal interview Tuesday, denied rumors that News Corp wants to sell all of HarperCollins.
Murdoch declined to identify the companies he is talking with, the paper said.
Murdoch said talks on a venture were triggered by the worsening economics in the book publishing business.
The newspaper said that Bertelsmann AG was the most likely investor in HarperCollins.
A spokesman for Bertelsmann in the U.S. said the company was always on the lookout for possible acquisitions, but declined to comment specificially on HarperCollins.
